question: How many customers have the gold loyalty tier?
reference_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM customers WHERE loyalty_tier = 'gold'

question: What is the average product price, rounded to 2 decimal places?
reference_sql: SELECT ROUND(AVG(price), 2) FROM products

question: List the coupon codes that give a discount of 15 percent or more.
reference_sql: SELECT code FROM coupons WHERE discount_percent >= 15

question: How many payments were made by UPI?
reference_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM payments WHERE method = 'upi'

question: How many products are inactive?
reference_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM products WHERE is_active = FALSE

question: List the names of all brands from Germany.
reference_sql: SELECT name FROM brands WHERE country = 'Germany'

question: How many reviews have a rating of 1 or 2?
reference_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM reviews WHERE rating <= 2

question: List the names and prices of the 3 cheapest products.
reference_sql: SELECT name, price FROM products ORDER BY price ASC LIMIT 3

question: What is the total stock quantity across all products?
reference_sql: SELECT SUM(stock_quantity) FROM inventory

question: How many products have a price above 10000?
reference_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM products WHERE price > 10000

question: List the names of the products in the Footwear category.
reference_sql: SELECT p.name FROM products p JOIN categories c ON p.category_id = c.category_id WHERE c.name = 'Footwear'

question: List the names of the brands that make products in the Mobiles category.
reference_sql: SELECT DISTINCT b.name FROM products p JOIN brands b ON p.brand_id = b.brand_id JOIN categories c ON p.category_id = c.category_id WHERE c.name = 'Mobiles'

question: How many different gold loyalty tier customers have at least one cancelled order?
reference_sql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT c.customer_id) FROM customers c JOIN orders o ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id WHERE c.loyalty_tier = 'gold' AND o.status = 'cancelled'

question: List the names of the products whose stock quantity is below their reorder level.
reference_sql: SELECT p.name FROM products p JOIN inventory i ON p.product_id = i.product_id WHERE i.stock_quantity < i.reorder_level

question: How many delivered orders were sent with the DTDC carrier?
reference_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM orders o JOIN shipments s ON o.order_id = s.order_id WHERE o.status = 'delivered' AND s.carrier = 'DTDC'

question: List the names of the products that have at least one review with a rating of 1.
reference_sql: SELECT DISTINCT p.name FROM products p JOIN reviews r ON p.product_id = r.product_id WHERE r.rating = 1

question: What is the total refund amount of returned items for products in the Laptops category?
reference_sql: SELECT SUM(r.refund_amount) FROM returns r JOIN order_items oi ON r.order_item_id = oi.order_item_id JOIN products p ON oi.product_id = p.product_id JOIN categories c ON p.category_id = c.category_id WHERE c.name = 'Laptops'

question: List the email addresses of customers who gave a rating of 5 to the product named Pulse Sneakers.
reference_sql: SELECT c.email FROM customers c JOIN reviews r ON c.customer_id = r.customer_id JOIN products p ON r.product_id = p.product_id WHERE p.name = 'Pulse Sneakers' AND r.rating = 5

question: What is the name of the supplier of the most expensive product?
reference_sql: SELECT s.name FROM suppliers s JOIN products p ON s.supplier_id = p.supplier_id ORDER BY p.price DESC LIMIT 1

question: How many orders used a coupon with a discount of 20 percent or more?
reference_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM order_coupons oc JOIN coupons c ON oc.coupon_id = c.coupon_id WHERE c.discount_percent >= 20

question: How many customers are in each loyalty tier? Show the tier and the count.
reference_sql: SELECT loyalty_tier, COUNT(*) FROM customers GROUP BY loyalty_tier

question: What is the average review rating for each category that has at least one review? Show the category name and the average rating rounded to 2 decimal places.
reference_sql: SELECT c.name, ROUND(AVG(r.rating), 2) FROM reviews r JOIN products p ON r.product_id = p.product_id JOIN categories c ON p.category_id = c.category_id GROUP BY c.name

question: What is the total quantity of items ordered for each order status? Show the status and the total quantity.
reference_sql: SELECT o.status, SUM(oi.quantity) FROM orders o JOIN order_items oi ON o.order_id = oi.order_id GROUP BY o.status

question: How many payments are there for each payment method? Show the method and the count.
reference_sql: SELECT method, COUNT(*) FROM payments GROUP BY method

question: Which payment method has the highest total amount among payments with a status of paid? Show the method and the total amount.
reference_sql: SELECT method, SUM(amount) FROM payments WHERE payment_status = 'paid' GROUP BY method ORDER BY SUM(amount) DESC LIMIT 1

question: What are the 3 categories with the highest total sales, where sales is the sum of quantity times unit price from order items? Show the category name and the total sales.
reference_sql: SELECT c.name, SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price) FROM order_items oi JOIN products p ON oi.product_id = p.product_id JOIN categories c ON p.category_id = c.category_id GROUP BY c.name ORDER BY SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price) DESC LIMIT 3

question: Which customers have placed more than 12 orders? Show the customer id and the number of orders.
reference_sql: SELECT customer_id, COUNT(*) FROM orders GROUP BY customer_id HAVING COUNT(*) > 12

question: What is the average payment amount for each payment status? Show the status and the average amount rounded to 2 decimal places.
reference_sql: SELECT payment_status, ROUND(AVG(amount), 2) FROM payments GROUP BY payment_status

question: Which brands have at least 6 products? Show the brand name and the number of products.
reference_sql: SELECT b.name, COUNT(*) FROM products p JOIN brands b ON p.brand_id = b.brand_id GROUP BY b.name HAVING COUNT(*) >= 6

question: What is the total refund amount for each return reason? Show the reason and the total refund amount.
reference_sql: SELECT reason, SUM(refund_amount) FROM returns GROUP BY reason

question: How many orders were placed in March 2026?
reference_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM orders WHERE order_date >= '2026-03-01' AND order_date < '2026-04-01'

question: How many customers signed up before 1 January 2025?
reference_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM customers WHERE signup_date < '2025-01-01'

question: How many customers have never written a review?
reference_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM customers c WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM reviews r WHERE r.customer_id = c.customer_id)

question: How many delivered orders contain more than 3 different products?
reference_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM (SELECT o.order_id FROM orders o JOIN order_items oi ON o.order_id = oi.order_id WHERE o.status = 'delivered' GROUP BY o.order_id HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT oi.product_id) > 3) t

question: What is the average number of days between the shipped date and the delivered date for delivered shipments, rounded to 2 decimal places?
reference_sql: SELECT ROUND(AVG(delivered_date - shipped_date), 2) FROM shipments WHERE delivered_date IS NOT NULL

question: List the names of products that cost more than the average product price and have a stock quantity below 50.
reference_sql: SELECT p.name FROM products p JOIN inventory i ON p.product_id = i.product_id WHERE p.price > (SELECT AVG(price) FROM products) AND i.stock_quantity < 50

question: How many orders placed in 2026 were cancelled?
reference_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM orders WHERE status = 'cancelled' AND order_date >= '2026-01-01' AND order_date < '2027-01-01'

question: What is the total amount of paid payments for orders placed between 1 January 2026 and 31 March 2026, including all of 31 March?
reference_sql: SELECT SUM(p.amount) FROM payments p JOIN orders o ON p.order_id = o.order_id WHERE p.payment_status = 'paid' AND o.order_date >= '2026-01-01' AND o.order_date < '2026-04-01'

question: How many different customers have placed orders that include a product from the Laptops category and also orders that include a product from the Mobiles category?
reference_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM customers c WHERE c.customer_id IN (SELECT o.customer_id FROM orders o JOIN order_items oi ON o.order_id = oi.order_id JOIN products p ON oi.product_id = p.product_id JOIN categories cat ON p.category_id = cat.category_id WHERE cat.name = 'Laptops') AND c.customer_id IN (SELECT o.customer_id FROM orders o JOIN order_items oi ON o.order_id = oi.order_id JOIN products p ON oi.product_id = p.product_id JOIN categories cat ON p.category_id = cat.category_id WHERE cat.name = 'Mobiles')

question: Which customers have returned at least 3 items? Show the customer id and the number of returned items.
reference_sql: SELECT o.customer_id, COUNT(*) FROM returns r JOIN order_items oi ON r.order_item_id = oi.order_item_id JOIN orders o ON oi.order_id = o.order_id GROUP BY o.customer_id HAVING COUNT(*) >= 3

question: What is the most common payment method?

What was our best month?
Which products are problematic?
Which customers are likely to stop buying from us?
Which order status is the most common?

question: How many orders has customer 117 placed?
reference_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM orders WHERE customer_id = 117
